label: Scrapbook experience
tagline: Raster-heavy collage pieces — vaporwave, cottagecore, Y2K, lo-fi, internetcore, dreamcore, mood-board
description: Crafts deeply-rendered raster-collage pieces where the aesthetic LIVES IN THE IMAGERY rather than in CSS — vaporwave, internetcore, cottagecore, dreamcore, weirdcore, liminalcore, Y2K, lo-fi, mixtape-cover, zine, mood-board, lookbook, Tumblr-grade. The sixth planner sibling. Inherits simulation-planner's discipline (research-then-drawers shape, lens trio with loop-until-bar, multi-draft cruxes via iterator-remix, hand-off split). What changes is purpose: where sim gives understanding, im gives creative-material body, nx gives presence, and game gives agency-toward-objective — scrapbook-experience gives the user A WORLD MADE OF IMAGES. The aesthetic itself is the artefact, communicated through dense raster composition that CSS alone cannot reach. The composition drawer co-dispatches visual-planner BARE-INTENT MODE per IMAGE INVENTORY entry — this is the most visual-planner-heavy of the six planners. PNG sequences substitute for transparent GIFs (generated frame-by-frame and sprite-sheet-animated). Handcrafted typography is first-class: hand-lettered raster headlines + careful web font choices commissioned via visual-planner. Concept-lens scores against successFeel like 'finding someone's secret Tumblr from 2008' or 'a real polaroid I forgot I took' — never generic claims.

triggers.title: Path A — "build a site" with this scrapbook inside
triggers.rule: User wants the scrapbook embedded in a larger app/site (a landing hero, an about page, an editorial section). Top-level Claude scaffolds the app shell (with `<iframe class="scrapbook-mount" data-scrapbook=...>` slot), then dispatches scrapbook-experience-planner per slot (Mode A envelope with slotFile/slotLine). After hand-off, top-level Claude drives the build per scrapbook-experience-planner.md §5.1.0 and embeds per §5.1.1.

triggers.title: Path B — Bare intent (the default for scrapbook)
triggers.rule: User wants the piece itself (a vaporwave landing, a cottagecore zine page, a Y2K hero, a dreamcore microsite). Default for scrapbook. Top-level Claude dispatches scrapbook-experience-planner directly in BARE-INTENT MODE. The runtime IS the artefact; no app shell needed unless the user names one.
